{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the unique values in channel
print("Unique channels:", df['channel'].unique())

# Check the counts of each channel
print("Channel counts:\n", df['channel'].value_counts())

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_count = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_count}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Check the first few values of revenue to confirm format
print("Sample revenue values:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())"}
